caption: Example SAR images (20 × 20 km) showing the continuum of atmospheric stability in order of increasing stability: (a) strongly unstable - micro-scale convective cells (MC); (b) unstable - mixed convection cells and wind streaks (MC/WS); (c) near-neutral - wind streaks (WS); (d) stable - negligible atmospheric variability (NV). The last image (e) shows an example of a biological surface slick, which is labeled as “other” in the present study.
